stories.headline: Ontario Northland’s tie purchase comes with four addenda
stories.body: Ontario Northland’s RFQ 2026 082 for supply and delivery of railway ties closes November 30 at 2 p.m., according to its current listing. Four addenda accompany the October 29 solicitation, including one dated November 23.

featuredResource.title: 14-day VT Forestry Climate Adaptation Challenge
featuredResource.description: This free 14-day email course delivers daily units with podcast links about Vermont forestry climate adaptation. The sequence offers a structured way to work through the subject over two weeks.
